scope.zh: 开工戴森球后邻国的道歉/赔款交涉链。
scope.en: The neighbour apology/compensation exchange after a Dyson Sphere is started.

texts.zh:
我们的帝国震惊地发现[dysonsphere_builder.GetName]正在[dyson_system.GetName]周围建造一个戴森球，那是我们最喜爱的星座——独眼漫步者——的中心恒星，而戴森球将完全阻隔她的光亮。

独眼漫步者，用她的独眼，自从我们的文明伊始便守望着我们，她的传奇不仅指引着我们的舰队，群星亦在天际间航行。而现在，[dysonsphere_builder.GetName]，伴随着他们浅显的傲慢，要用一个戴森球遮蔽她，弄瞎她。

虽然需要过上许多年，我们这才能感受到变化，但是当我们的人民得知她不能继续守望我们的下一代时，依然感到无比震惊。
texts.en:
Our empire has been shaken by the discovery that the [dysonsphere_builder.GetName] are building a Dyson Sphere around [dyson_system.GetName], a central star in one of our most beloved constellations, the "One-eyed Wanderer," completely blocking its light.

The Wanderer, with her single eye, has watched over our kind since the beginning of time, and legend has it that she guides not only our fleets, but the stars themselves in their journey across the sky. And now the [dysonsphere_builder.GetName], in their blatant ignorance, have built a sphere around her eye, blinding her.

Though it will take many years before we can tell a difference from here, our people are crushed that she will no longer be watching over future generations.

label.zh: 我们应得到一个正式的道歉。
1000能量币的赔款将缓解我们的痛苦。
label.en: A donation of 1000 credits could alleviate the pain.
Maintaining good relations with our neighbors comes first.

texts.zh:
我们发现您的帝国正在我们最喜爱的星座——独眼漫步者——的中心恒星上建造戴森球。

独眼漫步者自我们文明的伊始便用她的独眼守望着我们，她不仅指引着我们的舰队，群星亦在天际间航行，而您现在要在她的独眼上造一个戴森球，弄瞎她。

虽然我们要等很多年才能在母星感到变化，她不能继续守望的下一代的消息震惊了我们的人民，现在人民要求得到正式道歉。
texts.en:
We have discovered that you are building a Dyson Sphere around a central star in one of our most beloved constellations, the One-eyed Wanderer.

The Wanderer has watched over our kind since the beginning of time. With her single eye, she guides not only our fleets, but the stars themselves in their journey across the sky, and now you have built a sphere around it, blinding her.

Though it will take many years before we can tell the difference from here, the notion that she won't be watching over future generations has shaken our people and they deserve a formal apology.

label.zh: 给他们分享一些我们的能源币。
label.en: Share some of our energy with them.

texts.zh: 今天，[dysonsphere_builder.GetName]的[dysonsphere_builder.GetRulerTitle][dysonsphere_builder.GetRulerName]私下会见了[dyson_sphere_neighbor.GetRulerTitle][dyson_sphere_neighbor.GetRulerName]，就致盲独眼漫步者一事致歉。他们向我们真诚地表达了懊悔，并坚称即使漫步者失去了光芒，也将一如既往地用信念和公义继续指引我们。
texts.en: Today [dysonsphere_builder.GetRulerTitle] [dysonsphere_builder.GetRulerName] of the [dysonsphere_builder.GetName] met with [dyson_sphere_neighbor.GetRulerTitle] [dyson_sphere_neighbor.GetRulerName] in person to issue a formal apology to our empire for blinding the One-eyed Wanderer. They offered their sincerest regrets and remain confident that the Wanderer will continue to guide us, as she always has, using her strength of will and sense of justice, and not her sight.

texts.zh:
为了弥补因为戴森球的建设而造成的对我国和[dyson_sphere_neighbor.GetName]关系的损失，我们的[dysonsphere_builder.GetRulerTitle]千里迢迢赶到他们的母星并发表了诚挚道歉。

虽然他们还需要些时间才能从悲痛中振作，但他们感谢我们的付出。我们也希望从今往后两国的关系能得到改善。
texts.en:
In an attempt to repair some of the damage done to the relation between our empire and the [dyson_sphere_neighbor.GetName], following the construction of a Dyson Sphere around one of their most beloved stars, our [dysonsphere_builder.GetRulerTitle] traveled all the way to their homeworld to deliver a sincere apology to their people.

Though it may take them some time to recover from their loss, they appreciated that we made an effort. Hopefully from now on the relations between our empires will only improve.

texts.zh: 因为我们意外在他国最敬爱的恒星上修建了戴森球，为了弥补对[dyson_sphere_neighbor.GetName]人民的伤害，我们的[dysonsphere_builder.GetRulerTitle]千里迢迢赶到他们的母星发表了诚挚道歉，然而他们认为我们的苦心毫无意义。
texts.en: In an attempt to repair some of the damage done to the people of the [dyson_sphere_neighbor.GetName], when we accidentally constructed a Dyson Sphere around one of their most beloved stars, our [dysonsphere_builder.GetRulerTitle] traveled all the way to their homeworld to deliver a sincere apology. Yet, they have made it painstakingly clear that our efforts have been insufficient.

texts.zh: 今天，[dysonsphere_builder.GetName]的[dysonsphere_builder.GetRulerTitle][dysonsphere_builder.GetRulerName]与[dyson_sphere_neighbor.GetRulerTitle][dyson_sphere_neighbor.GetRulerName]亲自会面，为他们致盲独眼漫步者一事正式致歉。他们还赔偿我们1000点能量币以求弥补损失，并坚称即使漫步者失去了光芒，她还会一如既往地用信念与公义引导我们。
texts.en: Today [dysonsphere_builder.GetRulerTitle] [dysonsphere_builder.GetRulerName] of the [dysonsphere_builder.GetName] met with [dyson_sphere_neighbor.GetRulerTitle] [dyson_sphere_neighbor.GetRulerName] in person to issue a formal apology to our empire for blinding the One-eyed Wanderer. They also offered us a gift of 1000 energy in the hopes of repairing some of the damage they've caused, and expressed confidence that the Wanderer will continue to guide us, as she always has, using her strength of will and sense of justice rather than her sight.

texts.zh:
我们收到了你的要求，但是你们可能误解了我们之间的关系，让我们澄清此事：[dyson_system.GetName]是一颗我们星域内的恒星。或许你们难以搞清这个概念，但在我们星域内发生什么不关你们的事。同样，我们也不在乎你能否安抚你们的人民。

为避免更多误会，你们最好记住这点。
texts.en:
We have received your request and could not help but notice that there appears to be some confusion regarding the nature of our relationship. Allow us to clarify. [dyson_system.GetName] is a star within our space, and though this concept may be difficult for you to grasp, what happens within our space does not concern you. As it does not concern us whether you are capable of pleasing your people or not.

To avoid further confusion, in the future you will do well to remember this.

label.en: Don't dignify them with a response.

tooltips.zh: “你那可怜的小国马上就能体会到在宇宙中孤立无援的滋味了……”
tooltips.en: "Your pitiful empire will soon learn the meaning of being alone without a friend in the universe..."

texts.zh: 我们的线报指出，[dyson_sphere_neighbor.GetName]的人民就我们阻隔他们喜爱的星座的中央恒星一事，对我们拒绝正式道歉表示极不满意。虽然我们没有收到和此事件有关的说明，[dysonsphere_builder.GetRulerTitle]在一次演讲中表达了对我国的不满。
texts.en: Our informants report that the [dyson_sphere_neighbor.GetName] were greatly displeased by our refusal to issue a formal apology to their people for blocking the light of a central star in one of their star constellations. Though we've had no word from them regarding the incident, the [dysonsphere_builder.GetRulerTitle] expressed their disappointment in a speech addressing the empire.

texts.zh:
感谢你们花费如此长的时间来提醒我们那根植在你们物种中的卑劣本性，在这之前我们确实被蒙骗了。

你那可怜的国家马上就能体会到在宇宙中孤立无援的滋味了。
texts.en:
We thank you for taking the time to enlighten us, as it seems we were indeed confused about many things. The true nature of your kind among others.

Your pitiful empire will soon learn the meaning of being alone without a friend in the universe.

label.en: We look forward to that day.

label.zh: 他们会为他们的傲慢付出代价的！

texts.zh:
我们发现您的帝国正在我们最喜爱的星座——独眼漫步者——的中心恒星上建造戴森球。

独眼漫步者自我们文明的伊始便用她的独眼守望着我们，她不仅指引着我们的舰队，群星亦在天际间航行，而您现在要在她的独眼上造一个戴森球，弄瞎她。

虽然我们要等很多年才能在母星感到变化，她不能继续守望的下一代的消息震惊了我们的人民。而你，从另一方面来说，马上就能得到你想要的能量。一笔1000点能量币的赔偿也许能安抚你造成的痛苦。
texts.en:
We have discovered that you are building a Dyson Sphere around a central star in one of our most beloved constellations, the One-eyed Wanderer.

The Wanderer has watched over our kind since the beginning of time. With her single eye, she guides not only our fleets, but the stars themselves in their journey across the sky, and now you have built a sphere around it, blinding her.

Though it will take many years before we can tell the difference from here, our people are crushed that she won't be watching over future generations. You on the other hand, will soon have all the energy you require. A small donation of 1000 credits however, might help alleviate the pain you've caused.

label.zh: 我们没有足够的能量币，只能发表正式道歉。
label.en: We have no credits to spare, but issue a formal apology.

label.zh: 我们在自己国境内做的事可不关他们的事。
label.en: What we do within our borders is none of their concern.

texts.zh: 今天，[dysonsphere_builder.GetName]的[dysonsphere_builder.GetRulerTitle][dysonsphere_builder.GetRulerName]与[dyson_sphere_neighbor.GetRulerTitle][dyson_sphere_neighbor.GetRulerName]亲自会面，为他们致盲独眼漫步者一事正式致歉。尽管他们的道歉表面上很真诚，但他们拒绝赔付应有的补偿，理由是没有多余能源。
texts.en: Today [dysonsphere_builder.GetRulerTitle] [dysonsphere_builder.GetRulerName] of the [dysonsphere_builder.GetName] met with [dyson_sphere_neighbor.GetRulerTitle] [dyson_sphere_neighbor.GetRulerName] in person to issue a formal apology to our empire for blinding the One-eyed Wanderer. Though the apology seemed sincere, they refused to give us due compensation, claiming that they did not have the energy to spare.

summary.text:
# 独眼漫步者（戴森球外交事件） / The One-Eyed Wanderer (Dyson Sphere diplomacy)

- 分类 Category：银河轶事 C8 stories · 来源 Sources：events/megastructure_events_1.txt, common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

utopia.29 是隐藏事件，挂在 on_megastructure_upgrade_begin（00_on_actions.txt:3685）：FROM 为戴森球基址（dyson_sphere_0）时检查——本国未触发过、有一个邻国有通讯、双方观感 > -100、有经济或科技情报、非格式塔/灭绝等；随后有 35% 概率在 10–17 天后让该邻国收到 utopia.30，65% 无事发生（lines 645-746）。全球标记 dyson_diplo_event_global 使全局只发生一次。
Hidden utopia.29 runs from on_megastructure_upgrade_begin when a Dyson Sphere site starts upgrading; with a suitable neighbour it has a 35% chance (65% nothing) to send utopia.30 to that neighbour after 10–17 days. A global flag makes it once per game.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. utopia.30（邻国）：a 要求道歉（→utopia.31 给建造方，6天）；b 要求能量（唯物主义者 1800 天团结奖励，→utopia.32，1天）；c 无视（团结减少，链条结束）。
   The neighbour demands an apology (a), energy (b) or ignores it (c).
2. 建造方回应：31 的 a→33、b（付 1000 能量）→35、c→34；32 的 a（付 1000）→35、b→36、c→34。
   The builder answers in 31 / 32.
3. 邻国再回应：33 a→38 / b→37；35 a→38 / b→37；36 a→38 / b→37；34 a→40 / b→39（侮辱）。
   Final replies; 37-40 are the closing notices.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 全部是玩家选择；唯一随机点是起点（35%）。 All branches are player choices; the only random point is the start (35%).

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 31.b、32.a 需要至少 1000 能量。 31.b and 32.a need at least 1000 energy.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：utopia.29-40 的全部触发与选项（lines 645-1352）。编译树与源码一致；原先的 utopia.29 只作为隐藏入口，根设为 utopia.30（带 35% 与延迟标注）。
  Tree matches the source.
- 它发生于戴森球（见该故事）刚开工时，但独立于其建造阶段事件。 It happens when the Dyson Sphere is started but is independent of its stage events.
